description: Defines classes and functions for managing data elements, including DataStore, DataElement, LinkedDataElement, and DataElementParser, with support for memory management, serialization, and data searching.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: Manages a dynamically allocated buffer with memory management functions.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data segment with methods for reading, writing, copying, and searching data, supporting memory alignment and reallocation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Extends DataElement to support linked list of data segments, allowing concatenated data management.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Provides sequential access and search capabilities within a DataElement.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns or sets the size of the DataStore buffer.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates internal cache with data buffer details.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets DataElement to an empty state.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the buffer to the specified type boundary.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number of specified type and endian from data buffer.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number of specified type and endian into data buffer.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number pattern within data buffer.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Copies a segment of data into provided buffer.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Copies data from provided buffer into internal buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the data segment, reallocating if necessary.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a byte pattern within data buffer.
